test_title: SSC MTS Official Paper (Held On: 19 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error.'**

Sorry I will be late as a flight / has been delayed due / to bad weather.

options.text: Sorry I will be late as a flight

solution:
Here, the erroneous part is **"Sorry I will be late as a flight."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error in Option 2 is the use of the article** "a" **before** "flight." **
 
• We use the article** a or an** to indicate any non-specified member of a group or category.
 
 
• **Example**: *This is **a**__ ball.*
 
 
 
• Here, we want to locate the specific **flight.**
 
• The definite article** "the"** is used before a noun when the speaker and the listener both know what specific thing or person they are referring to.
 __
 
• 
 
**Example**: *I saw **the**__ movie you recommended.*

 
 
 
 
• So, we have to use** "the"** instead of** "a" **in this sentence.
 
• The correct sentence should be *"__**Sorry, I will be late as the flight**__ has been delayed due to bad weather."*
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.
